title: De-duplicate the Hebrew-script detection regex in TrackLearningOrderScreen
why: The adjacent comment admits this is a copy of CurriculumLabel's private _hebrew regex (core/labels/curriculum_label.dart:364); the same literal also appears in core/theme/text_styles.dart and core/enums/curriculum_id.dart, for four independent copies repo-wide of one RTL-detection regex. A future Unicode-range fix (e.g. extending to Hebrew presentation forms) has to be found and applied in all four places; missing one silently reintroduces a mis-directioned label in only that spot.
recommendation: Expose CurriculumLabel's Hebrew-detection as a small public helper in core/labels and call it here instead of a private copy.
acceptance_criteria: Only one canonical Hebrew-script RegExp definition remains in core/labels; this screen calls it

corrections: curriculum_id.dart does not contain a Hebrew-detection RegExp; it only has per-enum displayNameHe string literals (unicode escapes), a different concern. Duplication is 3 sites (track_learning_order_screen.dart, curriculum_label.dart, text_styles.dart), not 4.

core/enums/curriculum_id.dart does not contain any Hebrew-script regex (verified full 61-line file — only a doc comment mentioning 'Display name in Hebrew'). Real copies are 3: track_learning_order_screen.dart:161, curriculum_label.dart:364, core/theme/text_styles.dart:150 — not 4.
